sites.why: aider Coder.create(main_model=Model(...)) call for the code-writing/experiment step. This is a real, likely high-volume production LLM call path, but it is owned entirely by a third-party dependency (aider/litellm), not by this repo's source. Routing it would mean reconfiguring aider/litellm's own base_url/model-provider settings to point at Router -- which only serves /v1/responses and /v1/messages, not the chat/completions shape litellm's default OpenAI provider expects -- and was judged too deep into third-party internals to do blindly. A human should decide whether to pursue a litellm-level Router integration for this path or accept it stays on the original providers. The same pattern recurs at launch_scientist.py:245, experimental/launch_oe_scientist.py:191 and experimental/launch_oe_scientist.py:225.
